<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    cin.ignore();
    string input;
    getline(cin, input);

    int longestOutside = 0;
    int insideWords = 0;
    int currentOutside = 0;
    bool insideParentheses = false;
    bool insideWordExists = false;

    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        char c = input[i];

        if (c == '(' || c == ')' || c == '_') {
            if (c == '(') {
                if (currentOutside > longestOutside) longestOutside = currentOutside;
                currentOutside = 0;
                insideParentheses = true;
            } else if (c == ')') {
                insideParentheses = false;
                if (insideWordExists) insideWords++;
                insideWordExists = false;
            } else { // '_'
                if (currentOutside > longestOutside) longestOutside = currentOutside;
                currentOutside = 0;
                if (insideWordExists) {
                    insideWords++;
                }
                insideWordExists = false;
            }
            i++;
        } else {
            int start = i;
            while (i < n) {
                char d = input[i];
                if (d == '(' || d == ')' || d == '_') break;
                i++;
            }
            int length = i - start;
            if (insideParentheses) {
                insideWordExists = true;
            } else {
                currentOutside += length;
            }
        }
    }

    if (currentOutside > longestOutside) longestOutside = currentOutside;
    cout << longestOutside << " " << insideWords << endl;
    return 0;
}
